aggregation: All critical acceptance requirements must pass; scores are not averaged.
scope: Keep the Unix glue language small. Full-platform gates remain unmet and visible.

gates.evidence_and_gap: Native pipes, binary files, cwd, signals, and PTY tests exist. No stratified 100-command differential matrix; generic CLI exit 1, finite buffering, and literal arguments differ from Bash.

New local 1,000,000,000-byte probe verifies exact output hash, binary bytes, and two native launches. Compare a small input's high-water usage; Linux execution and broader slow-consumer/memory observations remain open.

New seven-case repeatable suite checks record cutoff, signals, timeout, blocked output, failures, and reaping. Local run: 1,000 cycles / 7,000 probes. The 10,000-cycle target, crash/descendant cases, and Linux run remain open.

Typed CLI input declarations now feed native parameters and argv, services and live bindings; 144 utilities expose 161 path inputs. General conditions, loops, functions and parallel jobs remain missing.
The 150 local utilities are **not** Omarchy ports. No pinned upstream sample or disposable-desktop differential run exists.
Pipeline failure, timeout, cancellation, uncertain checkpoint retry, and cleanup tests exist. Numeric statuses and stderr are not structured script-visible results; recovery branches are missing.

There are 28 shipped manifest entries plus manifest-free direct executable calls in 0.7.0. Arbitrary installed executables can run with literal argv, but this is not 1,000 verified backend integrations. Native/IPC/QML/remote backend abstraction remains absent.
Same-file terminal components have text ports. A `.program` cannot become an imported, typed, lifecycle-owned applet.

Typed declared text/integer/boolean/text-list inputs now validate against native parameter contracts, with scalar argv formatting. Raw byte pipelines, text bindings and UI projections exist. Native JSON/CSV record transforms, structured streams and typed component ports remain incomplete.
Bounded UI workers and stale-result rejection are covered at current scale. There is no general 1,000-operation concurrency primitive or randomized acceptance run.
A CLI such as `gh` can perform a request. Runtime-owned auth, reconnection, offline/version semantics, and fault-injected transports are absent.
Execute renders terminal widgets. No Quickshell bridge or twenty-widget desktop acceptance suite exists.
Warm-cache 0.6.0 local control/render measurements and historical matched Bash workloads exist. True cold-cache p95, idle-spawn guards, Linux parity, and representative end-to-end wins are unproven.
No held-out comparative generation study, token ledger, or repair-cost dataset. Source length and this project's successful examples do not establish productivity gains.

Private local control sockets, revision checks, tracing, bounds, and recovery tests exist. Applets retain user privileges; scoped permissions, credential policy, safe contract upgrades, and a month-long deployment study are absent.

gate_updates.evidence_and_gap: Pending candidate adds scalar conditions and typed same-file finite program reuse across finite/service/managed lifetimes. General loops, jobs, parallel execution, environment/redirection variants and complete shell compatibility remain missing.

Explicit native numeric statuses and scalar branches are tested; native timeout/cancel/I/O/signal failures remain failures. Whole conditional/call checkpoint nodes require explicit unsafe retry. Structured stderr results, broad recovery policies and exactly-once effects remain absent.

Owned CLI proofs execute five and sixteen nested finite levels with typed local scopes, exact call/return order, byte results and one native launch. This remains same-file reuse, not imported modules, lifecycle-owned child services or reusable helpers inside screens.

Native finite JSON parse, typed pointer selection, explicit encoding and JSON CLI/live inputs persist through checkpoints and CRUD state. CSV, structured streaming/map/filter operators and richer typed component ports remain absent.

Campaign retains paired local release measurements and raw samples for controls, JSON helper avoidance, completed resume and large live state. Reuse overhead is measured against explicit inlining; this is not true cold-cache p95, idle guarantees, native Linux parity or a universal runtime win.
